model: Sum-of-parts: owner-FCF DCF on consolidated operations plus equity-accounted infrastructure JVs, REIT stakes and investments via equity bridge (engine route)

equity_bridge.item: Joint ventures (equity-accounted infrastructure/utility JVs incl. shareholder loans) at carrying value
equity_bridge.note: Interim BS 30 Jun 2026 (line 2535). Post UK Rails and UK Power Networks disposals. FY2025 carrying HK$86,348m less UKPN HK$11,860m and translation. UKPN sold at ~1.9x carrying value, so book is a conservative anchor; dividends/loan repayments received FY2025 HK$3,310m.

equity_bridge.item: Associate: Hui Xian REIT 35.1% at carrying value post impairment
equity_bridge.note: Interim BS 30 Jun 2026 (line 2536) after HK$6,023m impairment to market value in H1 FY2026.

equity_bridge.item: Investments at fair value (Fortune REIT 25.5%, Prosperity REIT 17.2%, unlisted equities, debt securities, hotel project)
equity_bridge.note: Interim BS 30 Jun 2026: 7,025 non-current (line 2537) + 1,950 current (line 2546). FVTPL; dividend income HK$224m FY2025 stripped from flows.

equity_bridge.item: Perpetual capital securities (quasi-equity ranking ahead of ordinary shareholders)
equity_bridge.note: Interim BS 30 Jun 2026 (line 2568); distributions HK$286m/yr sit below profit for the year and are not in the operating flows, so the stock is deducted once here.
Interim BS 30 Jun 2026 (line 2569); flows are consolidated so the NCI stock is deducted once here.

historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity 5yr CAGR +2.3% vs EPS 5yr CAGR -6.9% and revenue 5yr CAGR +0.1%: EPS has fallen on investment-property revaluation losses, Greene King impairments and the shrinking infrastructure base while book value compounds slowly from retained earnings and translation. Owner-FCF CAGRs are meaningless on this series (FY2022 owner FCF HK$942m, FY2019 HK$37,249m) because development-inventory release swings OCF by tens of billions.
historical_growth.notes: Owner FCF series = reported FCF less interest income (SBC is zero): FY2020 20,257; FY2021 19,502; FY2022 942; FY2023 -5,373; FY2024 6,941; FY2025 14,315 (HK$m). Revenue FY2020 57,623 -> FY2025 57,935; EPS 4.42 -> 3.10; shareholders' funds 354,639 -> 396,442. The selected 2.3% is the equity CAGR and is used only as the long-run sanity anchor for terminal growth (2.0% base); near-term revenue follows the property-recognition schedule, not a CAGR.

scenario_narratives.base: Consolidated operations earn a mid-cycle 25% EBITDA margin on ~HK$55-60bn of revenue once the FY2026 Blue Coast handovers (high volume, near-zero margin) and the FY2027 recognition gap wash through; Victoria Blossom, Borrett Road Ph2 and the Yuen Long projects restore property-sales contribution at 20-25% from FY2028. Rental (Cheung Kong Center II leasing, Civitas) grows with indexation, hotels hold ~90% occupancy, Greene King stays a ~7% EBITDA-margin business after its 300-site restructuring. The infrastructure JVs, Hui Xian, Fortune and Prosperity stakes are carried at 30 June 2026 book; the HK$24.95bn of UK disposal proceeds sit in cash. Capital is redeployed at roughly book returns (buybacks or acquisitions are value-neutral in this model).
scenario_narratives.bull: HK residential recovery plus a Greene King turnaround: mature margin 28%, shallower FY2027 trough, 2.5% terminal growth and a 15x cap. Further JV monetisations at UKPN-like multiples would add value the bridge does not credit.
scenario_narratives.bear: Prolonged HK/Mainland property weakness forces discounting on the new launches, Greene King stays at breakeven with more impairments, GBP/AUD translation bites: mature margin 21%, 1.5% terminal growth, 11x cap. Balance sheet is not the axis; the risk is a permanent value trap.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Value what the consolidated business can earn through a cycle, add the holdco assets at book, deduct the claims that rank ahead of ordinary shareholders, and do not pay for a re-rating of the conglomerate discount. The equity bridge alone (JVs, REIT stakes, investments, net cash less perpetuals and NCI) is worth roughly HK$25/share, so the market is paying ~HK$20/share, about 0.4x their book, for HK$154bn of investment properties, HK$72bn of hotels and pubs and HK$102bn of development inventory. The DCF asks whether those operating assets can earn their keep; the P/B cross-check (base equity ~0.48x shareholders' funds, within the stock's own 0.37-0.46x range over the past year) says the base case is not a re-rating thesis.
key_risks_to_valuation: Property-sales margin on the next launch cycle (Victoria Blossom, Borrett Road Ph2, Yuen Long): the model assumes 20-25% from FY2028; FY2025 delivered 13% after Blue Coast provisions and H1 FY2026 3.5%.
Greene King: 45% of consolidated revenue at a ~1% contribution margin; a third consecutive impairment or a failed restructuring takes the mature consolidated margin below the bear path.

JV carrying value HK$73bn is taken at book; it understates value if stakes are sold at UKPN-like multiples but could be impaired (Hui Xian lost HK$6bn in H1 FY2026) if European regulated returns reset lower.
Capital redeployment of the ~HK$25bn UK proceeds: the model treats cash as cash; value-destructive M&A or a Mainland land grab would turn the bridge's largest line into operating risk.
Translation: 67% of borrowings and most JV income are in GBP, AUD, EUR, CAD and RMB; the HKD peg transmits USD strength straight into reported HKD flows.
Terminal cap multiple: Gordon at 8%/2% implies 17x; the 13x cap binds in the base case and the valuation moves ~HK$4/share per turn of the cap.

inputs.share_count_basis: 3,499,778,333 shares in issue at 30 June 2026 (unchanged since the FY2024 buy-back; no treasury shares, no share option scheme, so basic = fully diluted). Held flat.
inputs.debt_composition: Bank and other loans HK$43,777m (10,087 current + 33,690 non-current, interim BS 30 Jun 2026) plus lease liabilities HK$5,135m (4,742 non-current at 30 Jun 2026 + 393 current portion carried from the FY2025 note 21, the interim does not split it out). Company-defined net cash of HK$21.9bn excludes leases; the model's HK$16.8bn net cash includes them under lease treatment (A).
inputs.sbc_source: FY2025 Annual Report p.? (Extracted line 732) and H1 FY2026 Interim Report (line 825): 'The Group does not have any share option scheme for employees.' Remuneration is cash salary and bonus; SBC is a disclosed zero, not unavailable.
inputs.buyback_note: No repurchases in FY2025 or H1 FY2026 (FY2024: HK$1,546m; FY2021: HK$19,543m). Flat count is a fact here, not a convention the company has yet to fund.
inputs.price_as_of: 2026-10-16T03:24:47Z (HKEX morning session, live intraday print; 52-week range 36.74-52.35)
inputs.wacc_rationale: HKD flows discounted at an HKD-built rate. HKD is pegged to USD: HK 10y government yield ~3.6%, ERP 5.5%, equity beta ~0.95 for a HK property conglomerate gives cost of equity ~8.8%; after-tax cost of debt ~3.8% on HK$44bn of A/A2-rated borrowings (67% in AUD/GBP/RMB, ~50% floating post-swap). Equity-heavy capital structure (market cap HK$155bn, net cash) blends to ~8.0%. Same WACC in all three scenarios: cyclicality, GBP translation and the conglomerate structure are priced in the scenario flows and weights, not stacked on the discount rate.
inputs.lease_treatment: (A) leases as debt. IFRS 16 lease liabilities (HK$5,135m, Greene King pub estate) are added to total_debt; lease principal (HK$327m FY2025) is NOT deducted from the flows; lease interest (HK$243m) sits inside 'interest and other finance costs', which is excluded from the operating EBITDA margin; right-of-use depreciation stays inside the D&A line; ongoing lease-asset renewal is charged through ~0.6pp of revenue added to capex_pct (FY2025 principal 327 / revenue 57,935). Lease liabilities therefore appear exactly once.
inputs.nci_treatment: NCI stock HK$3,633m (30 Jun 2026) deducted once in the equity bridge; projected flows are consolidated. NCI share of profit is immaterial in normal years (FY2025: HK$25m; H1 FY2026 +673m was the NCI share of a loss).
inputs.excluded_income_and_matching_assets: Stripped from the flows: interest income HK$1,887m (of which HK$936m interest on shareholder loans to JVs), investment dividends HK$224m, share of JV profit HK$3,794m, share of associate profit HK$126m, gain on financial instruments, investment property revaluation, impairments. Their source assets enter the bridge at carrying value: joint ventures HK$73,055m (equity plus HK$~15bn of shareholder loans), associate (Hui Xian REIT 35.1%) HK$1,210m post HK$6,023m impairment (= market value), FVTPL investments HK$8,975m (Fortune REIT 25.5%, Prosperity REIT 17.2%, unlisted equities, debt securities, hotel project; 7,025 non-current + 1,950 current), and the HK$65.7bn cash via net_debt.
inputs.notes: MODEL: sum-of-parts on the engine route. CK Asset straddles two routing rows: a consolidated operating group (Greene King pubs 45% of revenue, HK/Mainland/overseas property development 35%, investment-property rental 10%, hotels 8%, management 2%) and a holdco layer of equity-accounted regulated-infrastructure JVs (ista, CK William/DUET, Reliance Home Comfort, Northumbrian Water, Wales & West, Dutch Enviro) plus three listed REIT stakes. The JVs contributed HK$8,662m of FY2025 segment contribution (HK$4,346m after their own finance costs and tax) but appear nowhere in consolidated revenue or OCF (JV dividends/loan repayments of HK$3,310m sit in investing), so a straight owner-FCF DCF on consolidated FCF would value the JV portfolio at zero. The consolidated operations are valued by component owner-FCF DCF (EBITDA margin built from the IS cost lines: revenue less property costs, pub costs, salaries, other expenses -> FY2025 HK$12,857m / 22.2%, FY2024 HK$12,005m / 26.4%, H1 FY2026 HK$5,802m / 14.4%); the JVs, associate and investments are added at book in the equity bridge; perpetual capital securities (HK$7,929m, distributions HK$286m/yr ranking ahead of ordinary shareholders) and NCI are deducted. The BVPS x exit-P/B holdco route was considered and rejected as the primary model because book is dominated by IAS 40 investment properties and development inventory whose earnings power is what the DCF measures; the P/B outcome is reported as a cross-check instead (base equity value ~0.48x shareholders' funds of HK$400bn, inside the 0.37-0.46x the stock has traded in the past year). FY0 ANCHOR: FY2025 reported FCF HK$16,202m = OCF 18,670 - fixed-asset capex 2,468 (ties to Metrics.csv; investment-property acquisitions of HK$229m are folded into the projected capex_pct, not the anchor); owner FCF 14,315 = 16,202 - 0 SBC - 1,887 interest income. FY2025 OCF included a HK$4,410m working-capital inflow from releasing development inventory; the projections set wc_capture to 0 (steady-state land replenishment = inventory depletion), so that inflow is not carried forward. The H1 FY2026 HK$8,961m profit on disposal of UK Power Networks, the HK$826m share of the UK Rails disposal profit and the HK$6,023m Hui Xian impairment are non-recurring and excluded from every path; the HK$24,950m disposal proceeds are already in the 30 Jun 2026 cash balance and the sold JVs are already out of the HK$73,055m JV carrying value, so neither is double-counted. CASH TAX: FY2025 profits tax paid HK$2,413m on operating EBIT of ~HK$10.7bn (22.6%); FY2024 HK$3,306m on ~HK$10.1bn (32.8%); statutory blend HK 16.5% / UK 25% / Mainland 25% plus land appreciation tax -> 25% flat in base. SBC-ZERO MARKET: house and street bases coincide; band_position is null by construction.

bear.narrative: HK/Mainland residential stays structurally weak: Kai Tak and Yuen Long launches need Blue Coast-style discounting (property sales margin ~10-12%), FY2027 revenue drops 30% and never regains the FY2025 level in real terms. UK cost inflation (wages, business rates) keeps Greene King near breakeven with further closures; GBP and AUD weakness shrinks translated flows; Civitas government-funding policy tightens. Mature consolidated margin 21% (below FY2025's 22.2%). WACC still 8% (risk is in the flows); terminal growth 1.5%, cap 11x. No solvency axis: net cash and A/A2 ratings hold, so the bear case is a value-trap, not a distress path.

base.growth_rationale: FY2026 +8%: H1 already HK$40.3bn on Blue Coast/Blue Coast II handovers; H2 ~HK$22bn (pubs 13.2, rental 3.0, hotels 2.4, management 0.4, property sales ~3.3 of the HK$6.0bn contracted-unrecognised). FY2027 -22%: recognition gap before Victoria Blossom (Kai Tak), 21 Borrett Road Ph2 and the Yuen Long projects complete; property sales ~HK$9bn. FY2028-29 recovery as those complete, then 2-3% (rental indexation, hotel RevPAR, flat UK pub volumes). Mid-cycle revenue HK$55-60bn matches the FY2020-25 average of HK$54.5bn.
base.margin_rationale: FY2026 18%: H1 actual 14.4% on near-zero Blue Coast margins (property sales contribution HK$765m on HK$21.6bn), H2 ~25% on the recurring mix. From FY2027 property sales normalise to a 20-25% contribution margin (FY2024 22%, FY2025 13% after provisions), rental ~77%, hotels ~36% contribution (~48% EBITDA), Greene King ~7% EBITDA (contribution HK$313m + ~HK$1.4bn depreciation), management ~40%. Blended 25% mature = midpoint of FY2024 26.4% and FY2025 22.2%.
base.capex_rationale: Fixed-asset capex FY2025 HK$2,468m (4.3%) + investment-property additions HK$229m (0.4%) + lease-asset renewal proxy HK$327m (0.6%) = 5.2% on a peak-revenue year; FY2024 equivalents were 11.9% on HK$2,893m of Civitas/IP acquisitions. 6.0% of mid-cycle revenue (~HK$3.3bn vs D&A ~HK$2.2bn) allows continued Civitas social-infrastructure additions and pub estate maintenance.
base.da_rationale: Depreciation HK$2,199m FY2025 (3.8%); roughly fixed in HK$ (pubs, hotels, right-of-use), so the ratio rises as revenue drops in FY2027 and settles near 4.0%.
base.terminal_rationale: Cap 13x owner FCF (method range 12-15x for cyclicals): blends 20x-equivalent rental income (4-5% cap rates) with 8-10x for development and UK pubs. Gordon at 8%/2% would be 17x and is not granted.

bull.narrative: HK residential recovers on lower HIBOR and stamp-duty relief: Victoria Blossom and Borrett Road Ph2 sell through at 28-30% margins, Mainland handovers restart (Greenwich Ph2), the recognition trough in FY2027 is shallower (-15%). Greene King's 300-site restructuring and disposals lift pub EBITDA margin from ~7% toward 10%; no further impairments. Mature consolidated margin 28% (above FY2024's 26.4%). WACC held at 8%; terminal growth 2.5%, cap 15x. Bridge unchanged at book, which understates the JVs if more are sold at UKPN-like multiples (1.9x carrying).

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 13x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised from the 15% default to 25% because the HK/Mainland residential market has been structurally weak since 2022, Greene King has impaired in each of the last two years (HK$1,233m FY2024, HK$1,620m FY2025) and the recurring infrastructure base has just shrunk by two of its largest stakes, so the base case already leans on a recovery. Bull cut from 35% to 25% because it needs three independent things to go right (HK property recovery, UK pub turnaround, accretive redeployment of ~HK$25bn). Bear is not a solvency case: net cash and A/A2 ratings mean the downside is a value trap, which is why it is 25% and not 35%.
probability_weighted.band_note: House and street coincide (SBC immaterial): the band collapsed, so band_position is null rather than a degenerate 0.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
